NPCFORGE.App.Title: PF2E NPC Forge
NPCFORGE.App.BaselineText: This first release proves the engine, registry, public API, document adapter, and reusable editor-session contracts.
NPCFORGE.App.NoPreview: Choose parameters and generate an NPC preview.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.GenerationFailed: NPC generation failed. Check the console for details.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.ActorCreationFail: NPC actor creation failed. Check the console for details.
NPCFORGE.App.CreateText: Generate a level-appropriate PF2e NPC from ancestry, class profile, and profession.
NPCFORGE.App.IdentityComingSoon: Additional identity and personality options will arrive in a later expansion.
NPCFORGE.App.EquipmentComingSoon: Detailed equipment options will arrive with the inventory expansion.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ReactiveStrike.Name: Reactive Strike
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ReactiveStrike.Descri: The NPC can react to a careless action or movement by an enemy in reach with a melee Strike.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.WeaponSpecialist.Name: Weapon Specialist
NPCFORGE.Abilities.WeaponSpecialist.Desc: The NPC is exceptionally capable with preferred weapons and uses the class profile’s high attack benchmark.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ShieldedGuard.Name: Shielded Guard
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ShieldedGuard.Descrip: The NPC fights defensively with a shield, using it to hold position and protect allies.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PowerfulSwing.Name: Powerful Swing
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PowerfulSwing.Descrip: The NPC makes a single especially forceful two-handed attack, an NPC analogue for a heavy attack technique.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.SneakAttack.Name: Sneak Attack
NPCFORGE.Abilities.SneakAttack.Descripti: Against off-guard or otherwise vulnerable targets, the NPC deals an additional {dice} precision damage.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.SurpriseAttack.Name: Surprise Attack
NPCFORGE.Abilities.SurpriseAttack.Descri: At the start of an encounter, the NPC can more easily catch foes off guard when acting from Stealth or Deception.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.TacticalStep.Name: Tactical Step
NPCFORGE.Abilities.TacticalStep.Descript: The NPC combines footwork and offense, briefly repositioning without giving up pressure.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BrutalAmbush.Name: Brutal Ambush
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BrutalAmbush.Descript: A hard hit from an advantageous position can intimidate and unsettle the target.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.HuntPrey.Name: Hunt Prey
NPCFORGE.Abilities.HuntPrey.Description: The NPC designates a creature as prey and focuses tracking and combat techniques against that target.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PrecisionEdge.Name: Hunter’s Edge: Precision
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PrecisionEdge.Descrip: The first effective hit against the prey deals additional precision damage.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FlurryEdge.Name: Hunter’s Edge: Flurry
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FlurryEdge.Descriptio: Repeated attacks against the same prey become more efficient; the NPC is built for rapid attack sequences.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DivineFont.Name: Divine Font
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DivineFont.Descriptio: The NPC has additional divine power for heal or harm. The concrete spell list will be added with spellcasting support.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.CloisteredDoctrine.De: The NPC emphasizes divine magic, knowledge, and support over weapon use.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.WarpriestDoctrine.Des: The NPC combines divine magic with armor and armed melee combat.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ArcaneBond.Name: Arcane Bond
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ArcaneBond.Descriptio: The NPC has an arcane bond that can restore access to an important prepared spell. Spell lists arrive later.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ArcaneThesis.Name: Arcane Thesis
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ArcaneThesis.Descript: The NPC follows a distinctive arcane method that will shape its later spell profile.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BardicComposition.Des: The NPC channels occult performance into a short-lived support effect for nearby allies.
The NPC uses performance to bolster allies’ confidence and combat effectiveness.
Performance can stand in for selected social approaches when that fits the scene.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PrimalCaster.Name: Primal Magic
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PrimalCaster.Descript: The NPC is a primal spellcaster whose magic is rooted in nature. Spell selection arrives with the spellcasting expansion.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LeafOrder.Name: Leaf Order
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LeafOrder.Description: The NPC emphasizes plant lore, restoration, and protective primal magic.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.StormOrder.Name: Storm Order
NPCFORGE.Abilities.StormOrder.Descriptio: The NPC emphasizes wind, weather, and electrical primal effects.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FamiliarPatron.Name: Patron Familiar
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FamiliarPatron.Descri: A familiar serves as the NPC’s supernatural tutor and conduit to a mysterious patron.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.HexMagic.Name: Hex Magic
NPCFORGE.Abilities.HexMagic.Description: The NPC has a compact set of patron-themed hex abilities in addition to normal spellcasting.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FateHex.Name: Twist Fate
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FateHex.Description: The NPC can briefly interfere with fortune when a nearby creature attempts a decisive action.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.WildHex.Name: Wild Hex
NPCFORGE.Abilities.WildHex.Description: The NPC invokes a short primal hex that hampers a foe or favors natural growth.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.QuickAlchemy.Name: Quick Alchemy
NPCFORGE.Abilities.QuickAlchemy.Descript: The NPC can rapidly produce a level-appropriate alchemical consumable from prepared reagents.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BomberField.Name: Bomber Research Field
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BomberField.Descripti: The NPC specializes in alchemical bombs and is expected to carry several level-appropriate bombs.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ChirurgeonField.Name: Chirurgeon Research Field
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ChirurgeonField.Descr: The NPC specializes in healing alchemy and medical support.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ToxicologistField.Des: The NPC specializes in poisons; later inventory integration may place injury poison on suitable weapons.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Rage.Name: Rage
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Rage.Description: The NPC enters a combat rage, trading restraint for increased melee threat and endurance.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FuryInstinct.Name: Fury Instinct
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FuryInstinct.Descript: The NPC follows a straightforward rage style focused on weapons and raw aggression.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.GiantInstinct.Name: Giant Instinct
NPCFORGE.Abilities.GiantInstinct.Descrip: The NPC favors oversized, punishing weapon techniques and conspicuous physical power.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DeviseStratagem.Name: Devise a Stratagem
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DeviseStratagem.Descr: The NPC studies a target before committing to a precise attack or investigative maneuver.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PursueLead.Name: Pursue a Lead
NPCFORGE.Abilities.PursueLead.Descriptio: The NPC maintains one or more active investigative leads that sharpen relevant checks.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.EmpiricismMethodology: The NPC excels at rapid observation, recall, and evidence-based deduction.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ForensicMethodology.D: The NPC combines investigation with advanced medical examination and treatment.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Panache.Name: Panache
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Panache.Description: Successful stylish actions can grant the NPC a temporary state of heightened confidence and mobility.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Finisher.Name: Finisher
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Finisher.Description: The NPC can spend panache on a decisive flourish-like attack with increased impact.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BraggartStyle.Name: Braggart Style
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BraggartStyle.Descrip: The NPC gains panache through intimidation and theatrical bravado.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FencerStyle.Name: Fencer Style
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FencerStyle.Descripti: The NPC gains panache through deceptive fencing and precise footwork.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FlurryOfBlows.Name: Flurry of Blows
NPCFORGE.Abilities.FlurryOfBlows.Descrip: The NPC makes two unarmed Strikes in a compact burst, applying the normal multiple-attack progression.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.IncredibleMovement.De: The NPC is notably faster and more mobile than an ordinary combatant of the same ancestry.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.MobileStance.Name: Mobile Stance
NPCFORGE.Abilities.MobileStance.Descript: The NPC adopts an agile stance emphasizing rapid repositioning and evasive attacks.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.MountainStance.Name: Mountain Stance
NPCFORGE.Abilities.MountainStance.Descri: The NPC adopts a rooted stance emphasizing defense, strength, and resistance to forced movement.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.OracleMystery.Name: Divine Mystery
NPCFORGE.Abilities.OracleMystery.Descrip: The NPC channels divine power through a personal mystery rather than a clerical doctrine.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Cursebound.Name: Cursebound
NPCFORGE.Abilities.Cursebound.Descriptio: Some of the NPC’s strongest revelation-style abilities advance a supernatural curse state.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BattleMystery.Name: Battle Mystery
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BattleMystery.Descrip: The NPC’s mystery pushes its divine power toward armed conflict and personal durability.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LifeMystery.Name: Life Mystery
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LifeMystery.Descripti: The NPC’s mystery emphasizes healing, vitality, and the dangerous extremes of life energy.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ChampionReaction.Name: Champion Reaction
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ChampionReaction.Desc: The NPC can react when an enemy harms an ally, reducing or answering that harm according to its cause.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DevotedArmament.Name: Devoted Armament
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DevotedArmament.Descr: The NPC’s favored weapon and defensive equipment reflect a divine martial calling.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.RedeemerCause.Name: Redeemer Cause
NPCFORGE.Abilities.RedeemerCause.Descrip: The NPC favors de-escalation and protective reactions that punish continued aggression.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LiberatorCause.Name: Liberator Cause
NPCFORGE.Abilities.LiberatorCause.Descri: The NPC’s protective reaction emphasizes freeing allies from restraint and repositioning them.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BloodlineMagic.Name: Bloodline Magic
NPCFORGE.Abilities.BloodlineMagic.Descri: The NPC is a spontaneous spellcaster whose tradition and signature effects are determined by a magical bloodline.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.DraconicBloodline.Des: The NPC’s bloodline favors draconic resilience and elemental or arcane expressions.
NPCFORGE.Abilities.ElementalBloodline.De: The NPC’s bloodline channels a chosen element through primal magic.
NPCFORGE.App.EquipmentGeneratedText: Equipment is assembled automatically from class, profession, and level.
NPCFORGE.Fields.Name: Name
NPCFORGE.Appearance.Traits.ScarBrow: a faded scar through one eyebrow
NPCFORGE.Appearance.Traits.ScarCheek: an old scar across one cheek
NPCFORGE.Appearance.Traits.BurnScarHand: an old burn scar on one hand
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Reserved.Des: Speaks carefully, watches reactions, and rarely volunteers more than necessary.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Warm.Name: Warm
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Warm.Descrip: Greets others openly and tries to make them feel at ease.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Stern.Name: Stern
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Stern.Descri: Uses few words, expects discipline, and dislikes wasted time.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Alert.Name: Alert
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Alert.Descri: Continuously scans the room and notices small changes in behavior.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Cheerful.Des: Keeps an upbeat tone and readily finds reasons to smile.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Weary.Name: Weary
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Weary.Descri: Seems tired but experienced, as if little still surprises them.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Practical.De: Prefers useful solutions over elegant theories.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Loyal.Name: Loyal
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Loyal.Descri: Stands by people and institutions once trust has been earned.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Curious.Name: Curious
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Curious.Desc: Asks follow-up questions and is drawn to unfamiliar details.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Patient.Name: Patient
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Patient.Desc: Rarely rushes others and is comfortable waiting for the right moment.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Ambitious.De: Looks for opportunities to improve status, influence, or mastery.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Generous.Des: Readily shares time, food, money, or useful information.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Suspicious.D: Assumes there is more to every story and tests claims before trusting them.
Keeps routines, controls emotion, and follows through on commitments.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Witty.Name: Witty
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Witty.Descri: Responds quickly with dry observations or playful verbal turns.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Compassionat: Notices distress quickly and tries to reduce suffering.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Stubborn.Des: Once committed, changes course only with strong evidence or pressure.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Meticulous.D: Pays attention to tiny inconsistencies and dislikes unfinished work.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Family.Name: Family
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Family.Descr: Protecting or supporting family is the strongest long-term priority.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Duty.Name: Duty
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Duty.Descrip: Feels responsible for a role, oath, office, or community.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Wealth.Name: Wealth
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Wealth.Descr: Seeks financial security, comfort, or the leverage that money provides.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Knowledge.De: Wants to understand something hidden, difficult, or forgotten.
Wants achievements to be seen, remembered, and respected.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Faith.Name: Faith
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Faith.Descri: Tries to live according to a spiritual conviction or sacred obligation.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Freedom.Name: Freedom
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Freedom.Desc: Values independence and resists being controlled by others.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Redemption.D: Wants to make amends for an earlier choice or failure.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Pride.Name: Pride
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Pride.Descri: Takes criticism personally, especially when competence or status is questioned.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Impatient.De: Pushes for quick decisions and becomes irritated by delays.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Greedy.Name: Greedy
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Greedy.Descr: Finds it difficult to ignore a profitable opportunity.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Gullible.Des: Wants plausible stories to be true and can trust confident speakers too quickly.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Cowardly.Des: Avoids personal danger when a safer alternative exists.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Vindictive.D: Remembers slights and looks for chances to settle scores.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Rigid.Name: Rigid
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Rigid.Descri: Has difficulty adapting when rules, plans, or expectations suddenly change.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Reckless.Des: Acts before fully considering consequences when excited, angry, or challenged.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Proverbs.Des: Frequently frames advice and judgments as sayings or old wisdom.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Coin.Name: Turns a coin
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Coin.Descrip: Rolls a coin across the knuckles while thinking or negotiating.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.BusyHands.De: Touches, adjusts, or inspects nearby objects while talking.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Notes.Name: Constant notes
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Notes.Descri: Writes down names, observations, and curious details whenever possible.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.EyeContact.D: Rarely holds direct eye contact for more than a moment.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Animals.Name: Fond of animals
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Animals.Desc: Becomes noticeably softer and more talkative around animals.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Cleaning.Des: Straightens tools, clothing, or tableware almost unconsciously.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Humming.Name: Hums quietly
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Humming.Desc: Hums fragments of familiar melodies during pauses or routine work.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Debt.Name: Hidden debt
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Debt.Descrip: Owes a significant sum to someone who may soon demand payment.
Committed a serious offense that has never been connected to them.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Informant.De: Quietly passes information to another faction or authority.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.ForbiddenLov: Maintains a relationship that would cause scandal or conflict if exposed.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.FalseIdentit: The public identity is incomplete or deliberately fabricated.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.HiddenFailur: A past professional failure still shapes decisions and is carefully concealed.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Heresy.Name: Private heresy
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.Heresy.Descr: Privately doubts or rejects an important doctrine of the surrounding faith.
NPCFORGE.Personality.Traits.StolenItem.D: Keeps an object that rightfully belongs to someone else.
NPCFORGE.Integrations.PersonalItems: Generate a personal valuable / art object
NPCFORGE.Integrations.ItemForgeReady: Item Forge available: personal items are materialized during Actor creation.
NPCFORGE.Integrations.ItemForgeUnavailab: Item Forge unavailable: personal items will be skipped.
NPCFORGE.Integrations.AfflictionForgeRea: Affliction Forge available: suitable injury poisons can be attached automatically.
NPCFORGE.Integrations.AfflictionForgeUna: Affliction Forge unavailable: poison integration will be skipped.
NPCFORGE.Integrations.ItemForgeFailed: Item Forge personal item generation failed
NPCFORGE.Integrations.PoisonPolicyAlways: Always when a suitable poison is available
NPCFORGE.Integrations.AfflictionDetails: Enabled libraries: {libraries} · injury poisons in preferred level range: {poisons} · found overall: {total}
NPCFORGE.Notifications.PoisonApplied: Affliction Forge: attached {poison} with {charges} charge(s) to the Strike.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.PoisonUnavailable: Affliction Forge is not ready. No poison was attached.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.PoisonNoEligibleA: No suitable slashing or piercing Strike is available for an injury poison.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.PoisonChanceSkipp: The automatic poison chance did not select a poison for this NPC.
NPCFORGE.Notifications.PoisonNoMatch: Affliction Forge currently exposes no enabled injury poison that can be used.
Grew up in or near the community and knows its everyday rhythms, families, and unwritten rules.
Was raised among farms, forests, or small settlements where practical work and local ties mattered more than status.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.OriginMigran: Came from another region and built a place here through work, persistence, and new connections.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.OriginPrivil: Had access to money, education, influential contacts, or social expectations that still shape their choices.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.OriginHumble: Learned early to make do with little and values useful skills, steady work, and reliable people.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.OriginDispla: Lost an earlier home through conflict, disaster, persecution, or circumstance and had to begin again elsewhere.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeApp: A strict apprenticeship taught discipline, craft pride, and the value of doing a job properly.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeSer: Military, civic, or guard service taught routines, hierarchy, and how people behave when pressure rises.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeFam: Learned the profession within the family and still measures success against inherited standards and obligations.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeAca: Spent formative years in structured study, surrounded by teachers, rivals, books, and arguments over expertise.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeFai: Faith, temple life, or religious customs provided a strong moral and social framework during youth.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeHar: A period of poverty, instability, or danger taught caution, endurance, and how quickly security can disappear.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.FormativeRoa: Travel exposed the NPC to unfamiliar customs, unreliable companions, and the practical value of adaptability.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.SituationSta: Work, home, and routine are reasonably secure, giving the NPC something concrete to protect.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.SituationAdv: Recent successes have opened doors, and the NPC is trying to turn momentum into lasting status or influence.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.SituationPre: One failed deal, accusation, or bad week could seriously damage the NPC's position.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.SituationOve: Too many people depend on the NPC, leaving little time for rest and making every new demand feel expensive.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.SituationTra: The NPC is between old and new roles and has not yet decided what the next stage of life should look like.
Money is owed to someone who has begun to lose patience, and ordinary income will not solve the problem quickly.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ProblemRelat: A relative needs help, protection, money, or attention, creating a responsibility the NPC cannot simply ignore.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ProblemRival: A rival is competing for clients, recognition, promotion, or influence and knows exactly where to apply pressure.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ProblemLegal: A complaint, investigation, disputed contract, or old offense threatens to bring unwanted official attention.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ProblemMissi: Someone important has vanished or stopped sending word, and the NPC has run out of ordinary ways to search.
Two legitimate obligations now point in different directions, forcing a choice that will disappoint someone.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.PrivateOblig: The NPC quietly owes a favor that may be called in at the worst possible time.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.PrivatePatro: A discreet benefactor helped the NPC in the past and expects access, information, or loyalty in return.
An earlier episode has been deliberately left out of the public story and could alter how others see the NPC.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.PrivatePromi: The NPC made a serious promise that conflicts with current convenience, ambition, or duty.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.StandingResp: People generally assume the NPC is competent and worth listening to, even when they disagree.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.StandingEsta: The NPC has a recognized place in local life and a network built through repeated everyday dealings.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.StandingOrdi: Known to some, ignored by many, and treated as a normal member of the community rather than a notable figure.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.StandingStru: The NPC is keeping up appearances but lacks money, security, or reliable support.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.StandingOuts: People recognize the NPC but still think of them as someone who came from elsewhere or does not quite belong.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.CommunityCon: Knows who to ask, who is feuding, and which introductions can solve problems faster than official channels.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.CommunityPro: Others rely on the NPC for goods, services, care, or practical help that keeps everyday life moving.
People look to the NPC when something threatens safety, order, or the vulnerable.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.CommunityAdv: Neighbors and colleagues seek the NPC out for judgment, specialized knowledge, or a second opinion.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.CommunityNew: Still building trust and learning which local relationships matter more than they first appear.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationRe: Known for keeping agreements and doing what was promised without unnecessary drama.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationDi: People believe the NPC can hear sensitive information without immediately spreading it.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationGe: Has a reputation for sharing time, money, food, or expertise when others genuinely need help.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationIn: Even routine conversations become more careful when the NPC enters the room.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationEc: Competent enough to be tolerated, unusual enough to be discussed after leaving.
NPCFORGE.Background.Entries.ReputationAm: Others have noticed that the NPC is actively seeking a larger role, more influence, or greater recognition.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Sibling.Des: A sibling remains part of the NPC's daily emotional landscape, whether through affection, irritation, or both.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Parent.Name: Parent
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Parent.Desc: A parent still carries expectations, history, and the ability to make the NPC feel younger than they are.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Child.Name: Child
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Child.Descr: The NPC feels responsible for a child whose needs can outweigh work, pride, or personal safety.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Friend.Name: Close friend
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Friend.Desc: A trusted friend knows the NPC outside their public role and can ask for favors that others cannot.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Mentor.Name: Mentor
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Mentor.Desc: An older or more experienced figure helped shape the NPC's skills and still commands unusual respect.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Student.Des: Someone less experienced looks to the NPC for instruction, approval, and an example to follow.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Colleague.D: A professional peer shares work, gossip, and practical problems with the NPC on a regular basis.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Rival.Name: Rival
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Rival.Descr: Competition with this person is personal enough that every success is measured against the other.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Contact.Des: A pragmatic connection can provide information, introductions, goods, or access when approached correctly.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Employer.De: Someone controls part of the NPC's income, duties, or advancement and therefore cannot be casually ignored.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Employee.De: The NPC is responsible for someone whose livelihood or duties depend partly on their decisions.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Debtor.Name: Secret debtor
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Debtor.Desc: Someone quietly owes the NPC money or a serious favor, creating leverage that may also create resentment.
NPCFORGE.Relationships.Types.Creditor.De: Someone holds a debt or favor over the NPC and expects repayment without public discussion.
